notes: Not in the pilot. The cover reads บริษัท บางกอกสหประกันชีวิต จำกัด (มหาชน); the name 'BUI Life' is taken from the file name. Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). Baht with satang, face and notes. Single set of columns. The SCI (p.12) prints expenses (insurance service expense, insurance finance expense, other finance costs, other operating expenses) as positive figures; they are turned negative. Its tax line is 'income (expense)', so the bracketed figures are expenses. No reinsurance line. Note 8.1 (p.86; columns group / ordinary / total, both years) prints expenses as positive figures and reductions in brackets; every expense line takes sign -1. No PAA business; other revenue = รายการอื่น. CSM roll-forward 9.2 total table (รวม) p.94 (2568) and p.95 (2567); p.96 onwards repeats it per portfolio. New business 9.3 p.100 (both years) prints only the total of future cash outflows: acquisition cash flows and other outflows are not disclosed separately (owner decision: not disclosed, no estimate); the total is kept as the memo figure nb_pv_outflows and reconciles. RA release uses 8.1 (6,751,627.00 / 4,631,965.04), not the AOC RA (6,701,401.14 / 4,750,210.31). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses.
